## Open science and scientific dissemination

**2026 — MOVICI scientific website.** Design and publication of the MOVICI research website bringing together the programme presentation, papers, reproducibility resources and dissemination materials.  
<a class="resource-link" href="https://jeansebastienvayre-prog.github.io/movici/">MOVICI website ↗</a>

**2026 — Scientific video series.** Production of a five-video English-language series devoted to CAVL and the four articles in the MOVICI programme.  
<a class="resource-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJJXA5R7uEsg">YouTube playlist ↗</a>

**2026 — Reproducibility packages.** Preparation and harmonization of reproducibility packages for the empirical analyses and agent-based modelling developed in MOVICI-CAVL.
